decision_summary: The remaining higher Book ledger is adjudicated against current nine-peer ownership and current product scope. BOOK-ENG-008 is split, BOOK-ENG-009 is promoted, and BOOK-ENG-010 is removed from the critical path and replaced by a bounded qualification profile. No historical architecture evidence is rewritten or relabeled as current implementation proof.

dispositions.name: Professional publication and proof pipeline

DOCUMENTS: generic document conversion and artifact mechanics
CONNECTED_ACTIONS: external publication, upload, transmission or other side effects under explicit user authority

triggered_only: EPUB-specific production when publication requires it
publication-specific accessibility certification or conformance work beyond the normal document baseline
non_claims: Book does not own a generic document engine.
Technical export does not grant publication authority.
This disposition does not prove current DOCX/PDF/EPUB/native/provider fidelity.

dispositions.name: Book backup, restore and offline endurance
book_owned: semantic backup-set definition for a Book
offline continuity expectations for Book work
non_claims: Book does not create a second storage or backup platform.
Promotion in roadmap priority is not implementation completion.
Core durability evidence does not by itself prove Book semantic recoverability.

dispositions.name: Book-length comparative qualification
replacement: periodic exact route/model requalification when material model/runtime/provider changes occur
targeted independent and human/masterwork evidence where quality claims require it
whole-app Book integration qualification before production promotion
dispositions.historical_preservation_rule: Historical BOOK-ENG-010 research, tests and comparison evidence remain immutable provenance and may be reused as inputs when exact/current applicability is established; they are not deleted or relabeled.
non_claims: No permanent commercial/world-class comparison laboratory is required for normal release progression.
Representative regression does not synthesize human quality evidence.
Historical comparison PASS cannot transfer to changed subjects.

objective_closure.closure_basis: Current Authority-005/Topology-007 ownership plus recovered scope-reset evidence and live Book residuals were reconciled into BOOK-COMPONENT-ARCHITECTURE-001.

qualification_effect: NONE_BY_DISPOSITION. This closes the architecture/roadmap decision only. BOOK remains incomplete and all implementation, exact-target, native/provider, human, publication and production gates remain evidence-bound.
